summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launches, security-sensitive releases, monetization expansion, and rights-dependent data use. Conditional only for ordinary bounded reversible growth that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance baseline 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown; security and operations sweeps have no results; analytics quality is yellow; Amazon evidence is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, private launch gates, and existing evidence work. Do not approve new implementation, requeues, deployments, spend, telemetry expansion, monetization expansion, or unsupported ROI or causal-lift claims.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for searchwoot.com: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Progress is limited to partial API, terms, repository/configuration, privacy-policy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level source rights, deployed data flow and retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 consent/configuration/retention, log and vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results, GA4 analytics, and operational logs/Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and public/commercial use, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. Smallest next actions are respectively: complete the internal counsel packet; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking; and produce a read-only log/vendor/incident/request inventory.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker.

Affiliate and analytics activity may continue only conditionally within existing evidenced boundaries. Validate registered tracking IDs, destination integrity, disclosure placement, consent behavior, and deterministic link/build checks. Incomplete telemetry is not zero; aggregate Amazon earnings remain unattributed, and no site revenue, ROI, or causal lift may be claimed.
